answer: Each identity posts a 500 POA bond, split across three independent auditors who all must sign before release. Idle identities bleed standing at 20 percent per epoch, so a dormant account is a wasting asset. Concretely, a lagoon of 40 accounts left alone for one epoch loses more weight than registering gained them. The falcon watcher groups clusters by shared funding. Trade-off: honest agents post the same bond, so the rule taxes everyone to price out a grove of fakes.
